description: This file defines the Cache class responsible for managing SCSS cache operations such as storing, retrieving, and cleaning cached data related to SCSS processing within the project. It includes methods for cache initialization, cache key generation, validation, and cleanup.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A class managing caching for SCSS data, supporting cache storage, retrieval, and cleanup, with configurable options for cache directory, prefix, refresh behavior, and cache lifetime.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cache object with provided options, setting cache directory, prefix, and refresh behavior, and checking cache directory validity.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value for a given operation and content, considering options and last modified time.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Stores a value in cache for a specific operation and content, with associated options.

methods.name: cacheName
methods.description: Generates a unique cache filename based on operation, content, and options.

methods.name: checkCacheDir
methods.description: Validates that the cache directory exists and is writable.

methods.name: cleanCache
methods.description: Removes outdated cache files from the cache directory based on configured lifetime.
